result.title: EnerGNN: Learning Optimization-Compatible Energy Functions for Exact Constrained Combinatorial Inference
result.summary: Learning-based approaches to combinatorial optimization often predict solutions directly or use predictions to restrict search, while expressive energy-based models typically rely on approximate inference. We introduce EnerGNN, a framework that learns energy functions over complete binary configurations and minimizes them under explicit hard constraints through mixed integer programming (MIP). EnerGNN combines a graph neural network encoder with an optimization-compatible readout and a nonlinear energy head, enabling exact constrained inference over the learned energy. An optimality-aware contrastive loss trains the energy to reflect solution quality and constraint violations. Across Quadratic Knapsack, Combinatorial Auctions, and a personalized cell therapy supply chain problem, EnerGNN achieves near-optimal solutions with 100% feasibility. On the supply chain problem, it achieves a 0.05% mean primal gap and a 17.4$\times$ speedup over the monolithic MIP. The learned energy also generalizes to larger instances and supports zero-shot constraint injection, adapting to changing constraints without retraining while preserving feasibility.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 EnerGNN：用图神经网络编码器加优化兼容读出与非线性能量头，学习完整二值配置上的能量函数，并用混合整数规划在显式硬约束下做精确推断；同时用最优性感知的对比损失让能量反映解质量与约束违反，在多个组合优化任务上取得近最优且完全可行的解。
AI.relevance_reason: 组合优化领域工作，但与 LVR 有两条可供核查的线索：以能量函数对完整配置打分并做精确推断，可能启发对 latent 假设集合的评分与筛选；零样本注入新约束而不重训，可能类比推理期追加约束或证据条件。是否可迁移尚需判断。
